The token arrives as a QUERY parameter, not a path segment, and it is not declared as a param for that reason. It is in the URL at all only because an email link has no other carrier — so it is single-use, short-lived, and stripped from the address bar on arrival. A URL is written to server logs, browser history and referrer headers.

The LLP sits at the apex; Space, Time and Capital are its constituents; Governance is the constitutional layer that governs the other three — not a fourth business function. Every constituent states what backs it: a ratified object, a UFR field, a derivation, executable code, a REGISTERED gap awaiting a §33 amendment, or OUT OF SCOPE with the reason.
The asset code (PDB-01) is carried on the record today; a dedicated UFR entry is the E-06 gap to close when the field is next touched.
Carried on the Property record; the closed type set is an enum question, not a new object.
An attribute of the asset, constitutionally: the thesis names why THIS property. It moved from Intelligence to Space for that reason.
The lifecycle field. Pre-construction → construction → stabilised → disposition.
One object per instrument with kind, custody and hash — a folder is not a record.
Asset register entries with cost, life, and depreciation basis. Required before the first fit-out invoice lands.
Same object, classed improvement — funded from the Sinking Fund, which is why the class must be distinguishable.
Policy, insurer, sum insured, expiry. The governance calendar needs the expiry date to fire a compliance event.
Already ratified. Carries its source and confidence class — a management estimate is not an appraisal.
kind: approval. CRZ clearance lives here — the compliance mirror in Governance references it.
kind: warranty. Expiry-bearing, like insurance — feeds the governance calendar.
The register IS the set of FixedAsset records; a separate register document would be a copy that drifts.
How much time does each LLP Partner legally control?
One record per vehicle per year. The vehicle-level pool the allocations divide.
The year an allocation belongs to — distinct from the calendar year it is used in only once rollover policy exists, which is Decision D-07.
NIGHT_POOL stated per vehicle per year; each position takes floor(pool × stake)

The pool is stated for the whole vehicle and each position takes its floor, so the sum of every partner's entitlement can never exceed what the property delivers. Multiplying a per-unit figure would invent nights.
units_held over total_units_issued. The stake is the input; time is one of its outputs.
STATIC. It does not vary with usage, season or behaviour — a right attached to ownership, not a reward attached to conduct.
Days the vehicle withholds from the pool before division — maintenance closures, statutory closures.
Vehicle-level rules constraining when allocation may be drawn. Rules, never individual draws.
Directed out of scope, 1 Aug 2026. Usage is operation, and operation belongs to the Operating Company. The vehicle records who CONTROLS time, never who USED it.
Directed out of scope, 1 Aug 2026. Same boundary as Usage Rights.
Directed out of scope, 1 Aug 2026. A ledger of draws is an operating record. If it is ever pulled inside the vehicle, it enters as a §33 amendment — not as a quiet table.
What is the financial position of the LLP?
The same record Time reads its stake from. One register, two domains reading it — never two registers.
Per-partner: contributed, share of profit, drawings, closing balance. The LLP Act requires it and Schedule-form accounts assume it.
A settled contribution. The Member Law fires here and nowhere else.
Lender, principal, rate, moratorium, covenants. The ₹5.5 Cr facility currently lives as prose in slowspace.ts — a covenant nobody can query is a covenant nobody monitors.
Account, bank, signatories. Signing authority itself is Governance — the account is Capital, the authority over it is law.
Recognised revenue, by period and class.
